description: CARTA DELLA VIABILITA' 1:50.000 REGIONE MARCHE is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ambiente.marche.it. It shows all the regional roads with their classification, up to the provincial roads including the municipal and local roads, whether asphalted or unpaved, is reported with a thin section. The data referring to the road axis are derived from the computerization of the C.U.S. (aerial shots years 1978-1984) on a scale of 1/10,000. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "VIABILITY CHARTER 1:50,000 REGIONS BRANDS" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include viabilita. The listing shows 1990-06-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
